selection: All 24 O3 cases, exactly six per subtype: top-k tie, ROW_NUMBER tie, coupled choices, GROUP BY representative.

claims: Selection is frozen and all arms entered in denominator; no performance, generic SQL portability, or product-bug claim. Scoped comparison with the independently locked contracts.
